description: Returns Anki-rendered HTML, shared CSS, and standalone static HTML documents for one existing card. Supports front/back and light/dark inspection without changing Anki. Not a screenshot: JavaScript, navigation, media, and external resources are disabled in documents. Raw source is untrusted.

side.description: Which existing card side to inspect; Anki resolves fields and template filters

theme.description: Document color scheme; dark adds Anki's nightMode and night_mode classes

name: get-card-preview

css.description: Unmodified shared CSS returned by AnkiConnect

document.description: Standalone static HTML document with restricted markup and CSP; scripts, links, and resource loading are disabled

html.description: Unmodified side HTML rendered by Anki; untrusted source, not a safe document

title: Get card preview
